profile.summary: Musco Sports Lighting is a company that designs and supplies lighting for sports fields and other large outdoor areas. It provides permanent and temporary sports facility lighting, as well as lighting for entertainment venues and infrastructure. It is based in Oskaloosa, Iowa.
